reasons.companion-not-paired: This target has no usable pairing credentials.
reasons.connection-offline: The current host is offline. This action will not be replayed automatically.
reasons.host-admin-only: This operation is restricted to host administrators.
reasons.host-manifest-missing: The host did not provide a compatible capability manifest.
reasons.host-protocol: The host protocol is not compatible with this browser.
reasons.legacy-readonly: This legacy data space is preserved for search and export only.
reasons.missing-grant: This browser has not been granted the required device permission.
reasons.offline-cache: Cached data remains available while the host is offline.
reasons.offline-queue: This low-risk idempotent action will remain in the visible target queue.
reasons.operation-unavailable: The active target does not advertise a healthy implementation for this operation.
reasons.requires-companion: This capability needs a paired desktop or cloud host.
reasons.service-only: This operation can only run inside a trusted service.
reasons.unknown-command: This operation is not present in the shared command manifest.
reasons.vault-locked: Unlock the local Vault before using this target.
